scope: Bilingual employer entry in personal requests in autonomous DEMO
implemented: One visible employer block exposes legal form and RU/KZ names immediately, with formatted full names for documents.
Explicit IP/TOO/AO/NONE selection persists through request autosave, reload, recipient JSON and optional directory creation.
Optional versioned naming metadata is accepted only as a UI hint; existing full workplace names remain the authority and legacy names are never inferred or rewritten.
Directory selection, request-local name edits, and detaching the link have separate behavior; both local names and requisites are preserved on detach.
Failed lookup offers retry; delayed lookup cannot overwrite typed names, an explicit empty draft, or a newly selected form.
Creating a directory record is prefilled; an unknown POST outcome replays the same body and idempotency key with fields locked until confirmed.
The summary shows both employer names and a direct edit action; validation navigation waits until the target receives focus.
RU/KZ employer labels and feedback are localized and verified at 390px.

browser.environment: Local isolated PostgreSQL/API, synthetic tenants, Chromium desktop and 390px, RU/KZ
browser.harness: Development hot-reload sockets blocked so source recompilation cannot reset a browser scenario. Assertions retained; final clean run has no retries or failures.

integration.scope: Real request autosave/reload and Recipient JSON roundtrip; literal names remain authoritative with stale metadata

documentEvidence.protocolSpecimens: Two real DOCX/PDF pairs; each PDF one page; paired employer names verified in header and roster
documentEvidence.uiToIssuance: Real worker-generated BiOT card and protocol from UI-entered bilingual IP employer, frozen snapshot and PDF hashes unchanged after later directory edit

verification.visualReview: Final RU/KZ mobile fields, linked desktop form, one-page real protocol and both real card pages inspected; paired employer names correct, no clipping or overlap.
verification.buildEnvironment: Local Windows production compilation, separate .next-employer-final-build directory, DEMO_STANDALONE=0; deployment configuration unchanged.

runtime: Owned API 4168, web 3168 and disposable PostgreSQL 55468 stopped; listeners verified absent; fixture data and logs retained.
